request: 小恶魔虎娘主题，三个视觉稿
notes: Independent concept boards; existing skin boards inspected for family style. No executable skin or user setting changes.

jobs.name: 绯绒小恶魔
jobs.summary: 红黑丝绒、香槟金、蝴蝶结铃铛；奶油色候选区，俏皮哥特风。
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape 3:2 visual direction board for a Chinese typing IME candidate-window skin, part of the Tigirl (虎娘) mascot family. This is a presentation concept board, not a screenshot of a full settings application.
Layout: large clear Chinese theme title upper left; one broad horizontal candidate popup across the upper-middle with a LARGE tiger-girl leaning over its top-right edge; one upright vertical popup in the lower-left with the SAME girl peeking around its right edge; five round palette swatches and a small focused ornament study lower-right. Generous margins, all artwork completely inside the canvas. Calm uncluttered studio-paper backdrop.
Mascot identity: very cute anime chibi tiger girl with orange hair, visibly black-striped orange TIGER ears, warm amber eyes, fluffy orange-and-black striped tiger tail, expressive mischievous smile and tiny fang. Add two small curved devil horns that are clearly separate from her tiger ears, small bat wings, and devil-themed costume accessories. She stays distinctly a tiger girl. Outfit is fully clothed, charming, playful. Same outfit and face in both orientations.
Production-minded visual style: beautiful polished Japanese anime illustration, confident clean outlines, substantial color shapes, restrained highlights. Character face and silhouette must read well at actual small UI size; large mascot, a few bold decorations, not dense miniatures. A thin attractive frame, clean straight expansible middle sections, decorations concentrated around fixed corners and the character. Keep all mascot, wings and ornaments OUTSIDE the usable text area. Large simple typography and strong text/background contrast. Do not turn the whole frame into wings. No fog or noise over lettering.
Exact horizontal UI text: code "ab"; candidates "1 你好", "2 世界", "3 输入法", "4 虎娘", "5 候选". Exact vertical text: code "ab", then the same five candidates on separate lines. Highlight only first candidate, with a simple quiet tonal pill. No other interface controls, buttons, pagination, Windows chrome or logos. No watermark.
Direction: CLASSIC CRIMSON VELVET LITTLE DEVIL. Exact board title "01 绯绒小恶魔", small subtitle "虎娘 · 小恶魔主题". Rich crimson red, near-black charcoal, warm champagne gold and ivory. Pale warm ivory board backdrop; ivory candidate paper with dark charcoal lettering; first candidate in deep crimson on light rose. A narrow black-and-gold rim with a red velvet ribbon gathered at two corners, one prominent bow with a gold bell, two simple bat-wing corner shapes. Mascot wears a rich red velvet capelet with black lining over an ivory blouse and dark skirt, a large red bow at collar and tiny gold bell, short black curved horns. She rests her chin on one hand and teasingly lifts a small golden fork-shaped devil wand in the other. Black bat wings form a readable compact silhouette behind her shoulders; striped tiger tail stays obvious. Mood: playful little noble devil, elegant, warm, cheeky, not horror. Big bow, big face, few clean motifs. Palette swatches: crimson, charcoal, champagne gold, ivory, tiger orange. Ornament study: the single red bow/bell and simplified bat wing, no extra character portrait.

Direction: STRAWBERRY CANDY LITTLE DEVIL. Exact board title "02 莓糖小恶魔", small subtitle "虎娘 · 小恶魔主题". Distinct light sweet palette: strawberry pink, milky ivory, pale lavender, berry red with tiny tiger-orange accents. Soft very pale pink board backdrop. Smooth cream candidate panel, berry-brown legible text, first candidate dark berry on pale pink. Rounded pink enamel frame with a few broad candy-like highlights; a big candy bow with tiny bat-wing ends and one small gold bell; corners have two chunky heart-shaped jelly candies, not scattered confetti. Mascot has tiny glossy strawberry-pink curved horns, compact lavender-pink bat wings, wears an oversized ivory-and-pink hooded jacket with a simple bat applique, a white blouse and a modest pleated skirt. Large playful face, clear bold color blocks, cozy plush proportions, fewer lines than ornate fantasy art. Mood: affectionate mischievous candy imp. Use a compact frame with ample breathing room for candidates. Palette swatches: berry pink, ivory, lavender, berry red, tiger orange. Ornament study: one candy bat bow and one fork lollipop.

Direction: VIOLET GHOSTFLAME LITTLE DEVIL. Exact board title "03 幽焰小恶魔", small subtitle "虎娘 · 小恶魔主题". Distinct DARK magical palette: deep eggplant violet, ink-black plum, cool mint/turquoise ghostflame, lilac silver, warm tiger orange. Presentation background light cool lavender-grey so the dark popups stand out. Opaque dark plum candidate area, pale lilac-white readable text, first candidate mint on muted violet. Thin violet-silver frame with two angular-but-soft bat-wing corner accents and two bold stylized cyan flame shapes outside the frame. Restrained magical glow confined to edge accents, absolutely clean flat dark text area. Mascot wears a short black-purple magician cape with lilac lining and a high-collar modest dark tunic, gold bell tied on a small lilac bow, violet curved devil horns and small dark bat wings. She mischievously leans over a small closed purple spellbook, with one hand holding a simple bright mint flame above it; wry fang smile, lively amber eyes, orange striped tiger ears and striped tiger tail unmistakable. Mood: clever imp casting harmless mischievous magic, luminous night fantasy; no tech HUD, no horror, no complex occult diagrams. Large character and broad readable flame shapes. Palette swatches: eggplant, ink plum, mint cyan, lilac silver, tiger orange. Ornament study: one chunky ghostflame and one simple bat-wing corner.
